moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio zigzag-travel, written here): Dot travels the polyline 0,0 → 55,−28 → 112,24 → 175,0 px (demo ×1.15): x eases 0 → 175 in 920 ms sine.inOut and y follows the polyline as a function of x (sharp corners; forward motion never stops); the travelled path draws behind it as a 2 px accent line and waypoint diamonds fill as they are passed. Params: duration (0.92 s) · points (0,0 → 55,−28 → 112,24 → 175,0) · ease (sine.inOut).
